verdict.rationale: A government tax agency's online services could plausibly offer a natural-language or conversational interface, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only describes form-based web portals (BRO, CRA account), certified-software EFILE transmission and calculators, and nothing shows users can operate CRA services through natural-language commands. The llms.txt probes show only a soft 404, meaning no agent-oriented docs exist, which does not bear on a natural-language interface either way.
